release_notes: Fixed: the admin panel became unreachable at the server IP as soon as a domain was parked — the generated Nginx config had no catch-all block, and `certbot --nginx` rewrote that config on issuance and on every renewal, narrowing server_name and appending `return 404`. The config now always starts with a `listen 80 default_server` block, certificates are obtained with `certbot certonly --webroot`, and a self-signed certificate makes https:///admin.php open the panel instead of presenting a parked domain's certificate. Also fixed: /.well-known/acme-challenge was blocked by the dotfile deny rule, the config hardcoded php8.3-fpm.sock, and a config that failed nginx -t was installed anyway because the test ran against a file nginx does not include. New: `sudo php cli/nginx_sync.php` rebuilds the web-server config from the database and repairs renewal configs left by the old Certbot mode — run it once after updating. New: the admin panel path is configurable in Settings → System, so the login form need not sit at /admin.php; `php cli/admin_path.php reset` is the way back in. New: the {offer} macro now works in local landings, so a landing's buy button is written the same way as in Keitaro — Buy — and the tracker substitutes the URL of the offer bound to the stream, click id included. Fixed: reinstalling destroyed uploaded landings, because install.sh backed up the database, var/ and geo/ but not landings/ before rm -rf. The update button now explains git's dubious-ownership refusal instead of reporting it as an unsafe branch.
